name: Jog
instructions: Warm up with a few minutes of brisk walking.
Start jogging at a pace where you can hold a conversation.
Land softly under your hips with a quick cadence.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and arms swinging naturally.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A relaxed steady-state run that builds aerobic base fitness.
